/blog/mcp-server-security (new)New ~1,730-word vendor-neutral guide to MCP server security — the real risk categories (data retention, OAuth scope breadth, local-vs-hosted servers, third-party package provenance, prompt injection), a 6-question vendor-vetting checklist, then how ARLO answers each one (pass-through, encrypted-at-rest tokens, per-user audit log, one-click revoke) — including an honest disclosure that ARLO doesn't publish a SOC 2 report today. Closes the standing trust/security content gap flagged in the original 2026-07-04 audit (content.md item 12) and repeated in every worklog NEXT list since. BlogPosting schema auto-generated via the existing blog pipeline.mcp server security — checked live: 170/mo, KD 34, rising fast (40→170 over the last 12 months). Secondary: mcp security risks (50/mo, KD 38).askarlo.app/blog/mcp-server-security

Needs your attention (unchanged, now 10+ sessions): catalog.ts still marks Meta Ads/HubSpot/MailerLite coming_soon with their own stated ETAs past due (Meta Ads is 3+ months overdue) — blocks any further connector-matrix pages until a product-owner call flips their status or sets new ETAs.

Needs your attention (unchanged): off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 — the single most overdue item on the whole 12-week plan, needs a human with a browser (this sandbox has no outbound HTTP).

Next: content.md's original 12-post skeleton is now effectively exhausted of non-redundant angles (9 posts shipped). Next content session should re-scope from a fresh SE Ranking keyword pull off Cluster 1/3 terms rather than the original static list. A full weekly-pulse session (backlinks, CI, rank positions) is also due, last one was 2026-08-14.
